column2: SELECT toStartOfHour(created_at) AS bucket, max(usage_user) AS max_usage_user FROM cpu WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < '2026-01-04 00:00:00' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket;

SELECT t.hostname, toStartOfHour(c.created_at) AS bucket, avg(c.usage_user) AS avg_usage_user FROM cpu AS c INNER JOIN tags AS t ON c.tags_id = t.id WHERE c.created_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND c.created_at < '2026-01-04 00:00:00' GROUP BY t.hostname, bucket ORDER BY t.hostname, bucket;

SELECT t.hostname, c.created_at, c.usage_user FROM cpu AS c INNER JOIN tags AS t ON c.tags_id = t.id WHERE c.usage_user > 90 AND c.created_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND c.created_at < '2026-01-04 00:00:00' AND t.hostname IN ('host_0', 'host_1', 'host_2') ORDER BY c.created_at, t.hostname, c.usage_user;

SELECT hostname, created_at, usage_user FROM (SELECT t.hostname, c.created_at, c.usage_user, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.tags_id ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.usage_user DESC) AS rn FROM cpu AS c INNER JOIN tags AS t ON c.tags_id = t.id) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY hostname;

SELECT toStartOfMinute(created_at) AS bucket, max(usage_user) AS max_usage_user FROM cpu WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < '2026-01-04 00:00:00' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket DESC LIMIT 5;
